connections.how: walk forward between the tan square ottoman on your left and the white sofa with orange pillows on your right toward the white wall pillar ahead
turn right around the white wall pillar onto the light tiled floor with the white island counter on your left and the dark L-shaped sectional sofa on your right
walk between the white island counter on your right and the back of the dark L-shaped sectional sofa on your left toward the white wall pillar with the round clock ahead

connections.from: recessed dark wood media unit with TV
connections.how: turn left beside the media unit to face the seating area between the dark L-shaped sectional sofa and the open bi-fold glass doors
walk past the end of the dark L-shaped sectional sofa toward the four framed prints on the grey wall and the dark table ahead
turn left before the four framed prints on the grey wall to walk along the side of the white island counter
loop around the end of the white island counter into the narrow tiled passage with the island counter on your left and the cooktop on your right

connections.how: walk straight down the narrow tiled passage with the stainless steel refrigerator and secondary counter on your left, and the built-in wall ovens and dark open pantry shelves on your right

connections.from: pocket doorway at end of pantry
connections.how: step through the pocket doorway onto the open tiled floor and turn left past the dark metal cube shelving unit toward the dark grey wall with the world map wall art

connections.how: walk forward across the grey rug with the desk and world map wall art on your left and the boombox wall mural and tan lounge chair on your right toward the three narrow windows

connections.from: tan lounge chair by boombox mural
connections.how: turn 180 degrees away from the narrow windows, walk back past the desk on your right toward the white double closet doors, and turn right through the first doorway onto beige carpet

connections.to: double bed with coral pillows and two alphabet prints
connections.how: turn around past the mirrored sliding wardrobe doors, exit the doorway onto the tiled floor with the dark metal cube shelving unit ahead, and immediately turn right into the next doorway

connections.from: double bed with coral pillows and two alphabet prints
connections.how: walk forward past the foot of the double bed on your left toward the three narrow windows and armchair ahead on the right

turn around, walk past the double bed on your left and the mirrored sliding wardrobe on your right, and exit through the doorway onto the tiled passage with the white double closet doors on your right

walk forward down the tiled passage with the dark metal cube shelving unit, pocket doorway, and city names wall art on your left, pass the white sofa on your left, and turn right down the wood-ceilinged passage past the live-edge wooden console table on your right

turn 180 degrees away from the door, walk straight down the tiled passage with the live-edge wooden console table, eye chart wall art, and wall cutout on your left, and bear right onto the beige carpet by the white sofa
turn left past the round wall clock on your left to enter the tiled area with the white island counter on your left and the dark L-shaped sectional sofa on your right

at the far end of the white island counter, turn right past the four framed prints on the grey wall on your left and the dark table with wire chairs on your right to reach the sliding glass door ahead

turn right to loop around the dark table with wire chairs on your right and the open bi-fold glass doors on your left, head back toward the white island counter, and turn right into the doorway beside the grey wall with four framed prints

step through the doorway past the open frosted glass wooden door on your left, turn right, and walk straight down the carpeted passage with the mirrored sliding wardrobe with sunburst mirror on your right and the bed with the black throw on your left

connections.how: turn 180 degrees away from the sheer curtains and walk straight with the bed on your right and the mirrored sliding wardrobe with sunburst mirror on your left until you pass the open closet niche on your right

connections.from: open closet with white hanging shirts

connections.to: dark wood double doors with frosted glass

connections.from: dark wood double doors with frosted glass

walk_summary: Start on the beige carpet between the tan square ottoman on the left and the white sofa with orange pillows and cityscape wall art on the right, walking toward the round wall clock on the white wall pillar.
Turn right around the white wall pillar onto the light tiled floor, passing between the white island counter on the left and the dark L-shaped sectional sofa on the right.
Turn right past the grey armchair with the polka dot pillow on the left to approach the recessed dark wood media unit with TV and the city names wall art.
Turn left and pivot around the seating area between the printed glass-top coffee table, the open bi-fold glass doors to the wooden deck, and the dark L-shaped sectional sofa.
Walk past the end of the dark L-shaped sectional sofa toward the four framed prints on the grey wall and the dark table with wire chairs.
Turn left to walk between the dark L-shaped sectional sofa and the white island counter toward the round wall clock, then loop right around the end of the white island counter.

Walk straight through the narrow tiled passage with the white island counter, stainless steel refrigerator, and secondary counter on the left, and the gas cooktop, built-in wall ovens, and dark open pantry shelves on the right.

Exit through the pocket doorway at the end of the pantry, glancing at the doorway to the white vanity counter on the left, then turn left past the dark metal cube shelving unit toward the desk under the world map wall art.
Walk forward across the grey rug between the desk under the world map on the left and the boombox wall mural and tan lounge chair on the right, up to the three narrow windows.

Turn 180 degrees to face the white double closet doors, walk across the tiled floor, and turn right into the first doorway to approach the twin bed with the yellow throw, New York skyline print, and wooden crate shelving with the Chinese checkers board.
Turn around past the mirrored sliding wardrobe doors, exit the doorway onto the tiled floor facing the dark metal cube shelving unit, and turn right into the adjacent doorway.
Walk past the foot of the double bed with coral pillows and two alphabet prints on the left toward the grey armchair with the orange cushion by the narrow windows.
Turn around, loop briefly by the double bed and its mirrored sliding wardrobe, and exit the doorway onto the tiled passage.

Walk straight down the tiled passage with the white double closet doors on the right and the dark metal cube shelving unit, pantry pocket doorway, and city names wall art on the left, heading toward the white sofa with orange pillows.

Turn right down the wood-ceilinged tiled passage between the wall cutout with the dark counter and black-framed interior window on the left and the live-edge wooden console table on the right, stopping at the slatted wooden front door.

Turn 180 degrees and walk back down the tiled passage past the live-edge wooden console table, eye chart wall art, and wall cutout on the left, looking into the carpeted area with the tan square ottoman and white sofa on the right.
Turn left past the round wall clock to walk between the white island counter on the left and the dark L-shaped sectional sofa on the right.

Pivot left around the end of the white island counter to look down the appliance passage, then turn right and walk past the four framed prints on the grey wall on the left and the dark table with wire chairs on the right to the sliding glass door to the lawn.
Turn right and walk around the outer side of the dark table with wire chairs, passing the open bi-fold glass doors to the wooden deck on the left, heading back toward the white island counter.

Turn right into the doorway with the abstract line art beside the grey wall, pass the open frosted glass wooden door on the left, and turn right down the carpeted passage past the mirrored sliding wardrobe with the sunburst mirror on the right and the bed with the black throw on the left to reach the sheer curtained window wall and dark armchair.
Turn 180 degrees and walk back past the bed on the right and the mirrored sliding wardrobe on the left to the open closet with white hanging shirts on the right.
Turn around at the open closet and turn left through the doorway into the tiled area with the twin-sink dark wood floating vanity on the right and the grey stacked-stone feature wall ahead.
Turn around, exit the vanity doorway, turn right past the mirrored sliding wardrobe on the left, and walk toward the dark wood double doors with frosted glass.
Before reaching the dark wood double doors, turn right through the doorway with the abstract line art to re-enter the tiled area by the white island counter.

Turn right and walk straight through the narrow passage between the white island counter, stainless steel refrigerator, and secondary counter on the left and the gas cooktop, built-in wall ovens, and dark open pantry shelves on the right, passing through the pocket doorway.
Step out of the pantry passage, turn slightly left toward the dark metal cube shelving unit, then turn right through an open doorway past three vertical black-framed wall circles on the right.

Turn right inside the room, walking past the mirrored sliding wardrobe on the left and the bed with the orange pillow and two grey framed prints on the right toward the wire corner rack with orange signs and the window with the dark roller blind.

Turn around at the window, walk back past the bed on the right and the three vertical black-framed wall circles on the left, and exit the doorway turning left past the small square black-framed print on the angled wall.

Turn right into the doorway to the white vanity counter, facing the vertical newspaper-print wall strip with the floating dark-wood vanity on the left and the glass-enclosed tiled shower with the handheld showerhead on the right.

Turn around and exit past the small square black-framed print on the angled wall, turning right past the white double closet doors toward the desk under the world map, then turn 180 degrees by the dark metal cube shelving unit to face back toward the angled walls.

source.camera: held at chest height by a person walking
